_what: How an unknown sender is paired before an event rule answers them (src/sender-pairing.mjs, used by src/events.mjs rules that name `paired_senders`). An unknown sender gets a short code from `alphabet` (no 0, O, 1 or I to misread), valid `expires_minutes`, and an account has at most `max_pending` waiting codes per source. The person approves a code and the sender joins that source's paired list; until then nothing runs for them.

words.waiting: {sender} is not paired yet. Their code is {code} until {expires_at}; approve it to let their messages through.
words.full: {max} pairing codes are already waiting for {source}. Approve or let one expire first.
words.unknown_code: No waiting pairing code {code}. It may have expired or been used.
